title: CGT method statement and all CGT events (Div 102 + Div 104)
summary: The Div 102 method statement (s 102-5) computes the net capital gain: gains and losses per CGT event, CGT discount for eligible gains (Div 115), loss offset (current then prior years, ss 102-10/102-15), and inclusion in assessable income. Div 104 defines all 53 CGT events A1-L8 (the s 104-5 table is the authoritative completeness list): disposals (A1), use and enjoyment (B1), loss/destruction and endings (C1-C3), rights creation (D1-D4), trusts (E1-E10), leases (F1-F5), shares (G1/G3), special receipts (H1-H2), residency ends (I1-I2), roll-over recapture (J1-J6), special events (K1-K12) and consolidation (L1-L8). Subsection coverage: Div 102 steps 1-4 of s 102-5 mapped; all 53 events from the s 104-5 table mapped; s 104-5 subsection detail per event (time, gain formula) carried in node bodies; Div 115 discount percentage and Div 112 modifications are separate maps.

nodes.label: A CGT event happens to you (or you are otherwise within Div 102)
nodes.body: Part 3-1 of ITAA 1997 taxes net capital gains. The method statement in s 102-5: work out your capital gains and capital losses for the income year from each CGT event, apply the CGT discount to eligible gains, reduce gains by losses (current year then prior years), and the net capital gain is included in assessable income. Capital losses cannot be deducted from other income — only against capital gains.

nodes.label: Which CGT event applies?
nodes.body: Section 104-5 summarises all CGT events A1 to L8. The event determines the time of the event, the gain/loss formula, and the applicable rules.
